road-pacific-coast-highway-california-st.summary: A coastal highway from San Francisco, California to Dana Point, California, via Monterey. Key character: ocean cliffs; beaches; redwoods. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Pacific Coast Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 47 km this is Pacific Coast Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

road-pacific-coast-highway-california-st.story: 1675 km from San Francisco to San Francisco, about 27 h 55 of riding. On the way it passes Monterey, Big Sur, San Luis Obispo and Santa Barbara. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
